function.description: Retrieve the details of violating compliance policies for the network device.
function.name: api_getNetworkDeviceComplianceViolatingPolicies

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

remediationSupported.description:
Filters based on whether remediation is supported for the policies and the network device.

If not specified, all policy results are returned regardless of remediation support.

items.description: Represents a policy violation with details about its severity and counts.

errorCount.description: The total number of errors encountered related to the policy.

lastComplianceRunTime.description: The milliseconds since the UNIX epoch when the compliance check last ran on the device.

allOf.description: The severity level of the violation.
allOf.title: ViolationSeverity

allOf.description: The maximum severity level of the policy violations.

maxSeverity.description: The maximum severity level of the policy violations.

policyDescription.example: This policy ensures the protection of sensitive data across the organization.

policyId.description: The unique identifier for the policy.

remediationSupported.description:
Indicates whether the remediation is supported for the policy and the network device.

True only if all violations have remediation commands and all mandatory site variables used have values assigned.

violationsCount.description: The total number of violations related to the policy.

items.title: PolicyViolationDetails
